description: New in TD 2025.3: Generates text as 3D line strips and triangles. Combines functionality of Text SOP, Text COMP, and Geo Text COMP into the high-speed POP environment. Outputs 3D geometry that can be further processed with the full POP pipeline.

parameters.name: Text
parameters.description: The text string to generate as 3D geometry.

parameters.name: Font
parameters.description: Path to a .ttf or .otf font file. If empty, uses the default system font.

parameters.name: Font Size
parameters.description: Scale factor for the generated text geometry.

parameters.name: Output Mode
parameters.description: Line Strips mode outputs text as wireframe line strips. Triangles mode outputs filled triangle geometry.

parameters.name: Extrude Depth
parameters.description: When > 0, extrudes the text geometry along its local Z axis to create 3D depth.

parameters.name: Resolution
parameters.description: Controls curve subdivision quality. Higher = more points but smoother curves.

parameters.name: Spacing
parameters.description: Additional spacing between characters. Positive values increase spacing.

parameters.name: Alignment
parameters.description: Horizontal text alignment relative to the origin.

useCases: Animated text geometry with Transform POP
Text as emission source for particle systems
Laser projection text via Line Thick POP
Text tracing for LED wall content
Typography in point clouds and installations

commonCombinations: Text POP → Extrude POP (add depth to line strip text)
Text POP → Transform POP → Render TOP (basic 3D text)
Text POP → Sprinkle POP → Particle POP (text as emitter)

Text POP → Trail POP (text motion trails)

troubleshooting.solution: Check Font parameter — ensure the .ttf/.otf file path is correct and the font supports the characters being rendered.

troubleshooting.problem: Text is too small or too large
troubleshooting.solution: Adjust Font Size parameter. Default is 1.0 — use Transform POP for additional scaling after generation.
Increase Resolution parameter to get smoother curve subdivision on text outlines.
Ensure Output Mode is set to Triangles when using Extrude Depth > 0. Line Strips mode does not support extrusion.

troubleshooting.problem: Font file not loading on macOS
troubleshooting.solution: Use full absolute path to the font file. macOS system fonts may require copying the .ttf to your project directory.

localNotes.excerpt: Text POP: New POP that brings text as 3D line strips and triangles. Has almost all features of Text POP, Text COMP and Geo Text COMP but outputs 3D geometry.
